errors.evidence: The left y-axis, representing Efficacytop, has a labeled range from 80 to 95, not 80 to 98.

The dashed line (AlphaEdit Efficacytop) is associated with the left y-axis. At 3000 edits, its value is approximately 78. The description incorrectly reports a value of 1, which corresponds to the right y-axis.

The solid line (AlphaEdit noise_E) is associated with the right y-axis. It starts at a value below 1 (approximately 0.8). The description incorrectly reports a starting value of 79, which is a value from the left y-axis that corresponds to the end point of the other line.
The solid line for AlphaEdit noise_E ends at a value visibly above 5 on the right y-axis, at approximately 5.5.
The description omits the marker shapes for the two lines: square markers for AlphaEdit Efficacytop and circle markers for AlphaEdit noise_E.
The description does not mention the color of the lines, which is light red for both.
